title.narrative: Strengthening Information and Communication Technology Systems for Efficient and Transparent Public Investment and Tax Administration Project

description.narrative: The proposed project will support the Government of Mongolia in enhancing accountability and efficiency of public financial resource mobilization and management through improved information and communication technology (ICT), especially for tax administration and public investment management (PIM).

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3709: 88% of contracts awarded and 90% disbursed as of 19 May 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: Two systems were launched in 2020 on mta.gov.mn. platform. The platform hosts e-learning.tax.mn that provides information and learning tools to the public on tax reporting, tax payer registration, e-signature, etax.mn, and e-barmt.mn systems. The platform views/visits reached total of 336,507 and the tax administration information system has total of 2,121 unique users.Public investment management system version 2.0 was upgraded in 2019 and launched in 2020 receiving new project proposals for approval through the system. Currently mobile application and web platform are available to the public providing key information on public investment and status of projects. The customer satisfaction survey for TAIS was carried out in 2020, in which 63.4% provided positive response. The customer satisfaction survey for current PIMIS was carried out on February 24-25, 2022, in which 92.31% provided positive response.Percent of total GDP in 2021 in 25.19% and in 2022 is 29.2% according to MOF report.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Aug 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51084/51084-001-apfs-en_3.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: 1.a Report on business processes and system improvement for PIMIS prepared and approved (90.00%) - Surveys, studies and analysis relevant to the PIM system and business process analysis have been completed by the consultant team, respectively the team developed manual on business process and system improvement along with the public investment management information system solution and it is approved by MOF. The remaining works on business process and system improvement is planned to be completed in Q3 of 2023 by the PIMIS development and testing team.
1.b Report on business processes and system improvement for TAIS prepared and approved (100%) - MTA established working group to develop manual on business process in December 2017 and the work is completed. The manual on business process and system improvement was approved by the head of MTA in December 2018.
2.a Customization, installation, testing, rolling out of the base system for PIM completed (21.11%) - Activities planned for PIMIS development are in early stage of implementation and tendering. The team of 15 consultants are recruited/assembled and started developing PIMIS, current work progress of the team is 62.8%. Procurement and implementation of GD-01 (PIMIS end-to-end software solution and systems integration) and CS-10-1 (Third party audit consultant for auditing and certification of the PIMIS and ICT systems) will be carried out in later stage of the PIMIS development in Q3-4 of 2023.
2.b Development, testing, rolling out of tax administration base system completed (99.94%) - Strategy and work plan for necessary milestones and methodology to create big data warehouse of tax administration and management and required activities to develop Big Data management capability are developed. Necessary software licenses of Oracle, Cloudera, Tableau and Talend are provided and in use. Tax administration web platform and kiosk design development and upgrading is in post contract maintenance period with 100% progress.
2.c Needed ICT infrastructure for PIMIS equipped (93.09%) - Necessary ICT equipment was provided to public investment units of all aimags and relevant agencies. Supply of necessary ICT infrastructure equipment for new data center, and relocating service of existing data center are complete, relocating service of archive unit of the MOF progress is completed, supply of ICT equipment for MOF (RFQ-09) is postponed by EA.
2.d Needed ICT infrastructure for TAIS equipped (100%) - ICT equipment and software were supplied, installed and configured for TAIS.
2.e Needed ICT infrastructure for tax offices equipped (98.57%) - High-speed VPN network is installed in 300 points in 21 provinces and capital city districts in Mongolia connecting all tax offices to TAIS. Total of 23,640 meters of optic fiber cable was installed. Electric supply system and air ventilation system works are completed at the National Data Center. Supply of some necessary ICT infrastructure equipment divided into 5 lots, and lot#1, 2, & 5 completed and remaining lot# 3 & 4 are in the process of contract closing.
2.f Annex a new data center, renovate the office space for MOF completed (98.81%) - Construction works of the data center building is completed and in use, renovation of MOF office space and data center related consultancy work (CS-12) are in progress.
2.g At least two of existing internal/external ICT systems under the PIMIS cycle interfaced or integrated (83.67%) - All consultants under this indicator are mobilized, studies and system analysis are completed and approved by MOF. PIMIS system integration works are started and progressing. Currently, 2 internal systems and 5 external systems are connected to the PIMIS. 2 consultants with time-based contract are working as a member of PIMIS development team.
2.h Maintenance and adjustment of TAIS and PIMIS conducted on a regular basis, at least twice a year (37.12%) - For TAIS, supply of network firewall licenses for MTA is completed, supply of MS Office 365 license extension is completed. Supply of system software licensing is in the process of tendering.
3.a At least 50% of staff (with 50% female staff participation) trained for ICT system user interface completed (20training 110.49% staff 48.75% female) - In 2019, user interface training for 331 participants (female participants 62.24%) from all soum and district level tax offices is organized. In 2020, 1 training for 20 officers from MTA risk management and IT departments is organized (% of female participants - 30%). In 2021, workshop to finalize TOR for PIMIS development for 56 MOF officials and PIU consultants (% of female participants 35.71%) is organized. In 2022, up to the end of reporting period total of 6 trainings/seminars are organized, including, 1) 'Public investment efficiency national level training for 262 public officials (% of female participants 53.10%) from 21 province and UB city, 2) 'Strengthening public investment management and efficiency regional workshop, seminar for 83 public officials (% of female participants 27.71%) from western 3 provinces, 3) 'Strengthening public investment management and efficiency regional workshop, seminar for 21 public officials (% of female participants 57.14%) from Northern 1 province, 4) PIMIS pilot testing (investment project entry and real time online payment transaction) mission for 8 officials (% of female participants 62.5%) from Darkhan-Uul province, 5) Global forum on transparency and exchange of information for tax purposes for 2 officials (% of female participants 0%), 6) Study group on Asia-Pacific Tax administration and research -51st annual meeting for 7 officials (% of female participants 71.43%)7) Efficiency of public investment and PIMIS, regional workshop, seminar for 312 public officials (% of female participants 48.72%) 8) Procurement renewal & PIMIS integration. Total participants -14 (% of female participants 35.71%). 9) PIMIS user regional training. seminar for 519 public officials (% of female participants 44.10%).
3.b At least 50% of staff (with 50% female staff participation) trained for system-based management completed (5training 97.22% staff 36.11% female) - 4 international training/study tours 1) to Denmark on TAIS system and 2) to Japan on Data Center architecture in 2019. Total participants - 11 (% of female participants 22.22%). 1 international training/study tour to UK on PIMIS in 2022. Total participants - 4 (% of female participants 0%). 2 international training/study tour in 2023.1) to Turkey on PIMIS study/training tour. Total participants - 15 (% of female participants66.67 %). 2 to Australia on PIMIS study tour. Total participants - 8 (% of female participants 12.5 %), 1 Video content created for workshop/training.
3.c At least 50% of staff (with 30% female staff participation) trained for maintenance and upgrading the systems processes developed (5training 100% staff 9.45% female):
In 2019, 'Oracle database training for 2 officers (% of female participants - 0%) from MTA IT department organized in New Delhi, India. In 2020, 'Public Investment Information System and Digitalization seminar for 35 officers (% of female participants 45.71%) and 'Cloudera administration Data analyst training for 8 officers (% of female participants 37.5%) were organized. In 2022, 'Proposed changes to the existing regulations that govern Public investment management workshop for 38 officials (% of female participants 15.66%) is organized. In 2023, ICT for TAIS peer-to-peer study tour to Denmark for 1 official (% of female participants - 0%).
